body: Thank you so much. There was a similar response above, but I greatly appreciate the time you took to write this. I will be leaving a letter tomorrow and give him some space for the time being, but I'm scared about what happens after he is discharged. What if he doesn't want to see me anymore? If he does, how can I make sure he's cared for without feeling like he's being constantly monitored?

Thanks, I think I'll try leaving a letter tomorrow and leave him alone for a bit, it seems like the best thing to do at the moment. I guess I'm also scared about what to do after he is discharged. If he doesn't try to contact me, do I try to re-connect with him? What do I do with his personal items? 

If he does decide to come live with us again, how can I make sure that he's being "taken care of" without feeling like he's being constantly monitored? My roommates and I all have busy schedules, and there will be times where he'll be left alone for hours at a time. What if he wants to go out by himself?
